title: Zesty Crumbly Uruguayan Polish Sausage Skillet
description: A funky, crumbly, crowd-pleasing Uruguayan dish featuring Polish sausage, wok-hei, and macrobiotic-friendly ingredients. This recipe combines the flavors of South America and Eastern Europe in a unique and delicious way.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced Polish sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and bell pepper and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked brown rice, black beans, and diced tomatoes to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the mixture is heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
